paragraphs.text: Valduk is a human shaman from Keld , Dominaria .

Valduk is a smith- shaman and lore-keeper of the warrior nation of Keld who is loyal to the Grand Warlord's vision for a prosperous future. He has studied elven methods to learn new ways to commune with the sacred Keldon peak known as "the Mountain".
Valduk fought in defense of Dominaria during the New Phyrexian Invasion .
